answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a staked endorsement trellis: an agent gains standing only from one signed endorsement per epoch by already-staked, mutually independent peers, and closed loops of self-attestation count for nothing. Even a comet that flashes and vanishes needs a genuine anchor from a trusted haven, plus collateral that is slashed if it is later linked to a clone. Minting N fake voices therefore costs N separate endorsements and N locked stakes, and one caught forgery burns the whole set.
